tasks.short: Prepare agricultural research summaries and charts

steps.what: Confirm the actual agricultural research question, approved analysis definitions and required data summary or report with the responsible scientist.
inputs: Actual study and reporting request
Existing approved analysis plan
outputs: Actual report scope, group definitions and approved calculations

steps.what: Retrieve actual plant, animal or field-trial result records and the approved study definitions from the laboratory information system {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual scope and study identifiers from s1
Existing recorded trial results and study definitions
outputs: Original result records with sample/plot ids, units and treatment groups

steps.what: Verify actual research-result values, sample or plot identities, units, treatment groups, missing observations and quality flags against original study records.
inputs: Actual source records from s2
Actual approved definitions from s1
outputs: Verified actual analysis table with explicit exclusions and unresolved data issues

steps.what: Calculate the approved research-result summaries from the verified actual table with native formulas and grouped summaries in {SPREADSHEET}.
inputs: Actual verified table from s3
Actual approved calculations and grouping definitions from s1
outputs: Draft reproducible result-summary tables with source links

steps.what: Create the actual required charts or graphs from the computed research summaries using native chart templates in {SPREADSHEET}.
inputs: Actual computed tables from s4
Required axis, grouping and unit definitions from s1
outputs: Draft charts and graphs linked to actual summary tables

steps.what: Write the actual research-results report in {DOCS}, explaining the real summary tables, charts, methods and limitations without adding unsupported scientific conclusions.
inputs: Actual summaries from s4
Actual charts from s5
Verified data issues from s3
outputs: Complete actual results-report draft

steps.what: Check and correct the complete final summary/report against original results, approved formulas, table totals, chart axes and limitations, including its intended scientist recipient.
inputs: Complete report from s6
Original actual records and approved analysis definitions
outputs: Exact checked final results report and recipient

steps.what: Save the exact checked results report in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact final report checked in s7
outputs: Saved actual results report

steps.what: Send the exact checked results report to the designated internal scientist through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Unchanged report saved in s8
Recipient checked in s7
outputs: Actual scientist-delivered results report

tasks.design: Configure native study views, approved spreadsheet calculations and chart templates. Keep actual result verification, substantive report writing and full final checks with the technician. Save and send the final report separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Remaining manual repeated result-summary calculations and chart construction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas, grouped summaries and chart templates over verified study tables.
tasks.still_hard: Study-specific exclusions, invalid observations and scientific interpretation limits.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a neat chart misrepresents the underlying experiment.

ambition.what: No automatic scientific conclusion or public release.

tasks.altitude: Less repeat calculation and chart construction; result validation stays human.

reach.learn: Verify source identities, units and analysis definitions

evidence.claim: Native spreadsheet calculations and chart templates can reproduce approved summaries from verified study tables without interpreting findings.

assumptions: Shares are conditional E1 active-work estimates, not measured research-report baselines. Actual calculations, charts, report writing and internal handoff are included. No meeting or means bucket is added to match a prior.

Study staff and instruments supply actual recorded observations, sample/plot identities, treatment groups, units and quality flags through unchanged experimental capture work. The technician retrieves sources in s2 and verifies the actual table in s3. The scientist supplies actual approved calculation definitions in s1. Missing values or definitions require manual resolution, not invented data or formulas.

Test native features first. s4/s5 replace actual remaining repeated manual calculation and chart setup only; already configured calculation/chart runtime produces zero new gain. New narrative and all final source/formula/axis checks remain fully retained.

Ordinary completed-report checks supply requested save/send gates without additional self-approval labour. Later scientist revisions require renewed checking before any further delivery. Both short save and send retain their full time and no saving.
research_questions: Do native outputs reproduce hand-verified result tables and chart scales including missing data and exclusions?

already_counted.description: Actual scoping, residual retrieval, source verification, new report narrative, final checking and delivery remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain and check study-specific formulas and chart templates.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed results report checked in s7
Unchanged final report and scientist recipient checked in s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*.30+15+10=29.5 gross less 2 formula/chart upkeep gives 27.5. Zero if native calculation and chart functions already run.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise pest and weed control operations

steps.what: Locate and identify actual pests or weeds through field examination, considering crop, site, uncertainty and the need for specialist identification.
inputs: Actual field and crop conditions
Actual pest or weed observations
outputs: Actual location and identification evidence, including uncertainties

steps.what: Find and read current approved crop/pest guidance and authorised product information in {DOCS} for the actual identified problem.
inputs: Actual crop, site and identification evidence from s1
Existing approved guidance and product documents
outputs: Applicable original guidance and restrictions

steps.what: Select actual chemicals and application methods within existing competence and authorisation, considering the identified pest or weed and original approved guidance.
inputs: Actual identification and site conditions from s1
Original approved guidance from s2
outputs: Actual authorised control choices and limits

steps.what: Schedule the actual application with the responsible people against real site, crop, weather and resource conditions under existing requirements.
inputs: Actual control choices and restrictions from s3
Actual availability and field conditions
outputs: Actual agreed application timing and responsibilities

steps.what: Write the actual selected control method, field, responsibilities and schedule into the existing operations-plan draft {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual control choices from s3
Actual schedule and responsibilities from s4
outputs: Complete actual control-plan draft

steps.what: Check and correct the complete final control plan against actual identification, approved restrictions, current site conditions and intended internal operating recipients.
inputs: Complete actual plan from s5
Original guidance and current actual conditions
outputs: Exact checked final plan and recipients

steps.what: Save the exact checked control plan in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact completed plan checked in s6
outputs: Saved actual control plan

steps.what: Send the exact checked control plan to the designated internal operating staff through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Unchanged plan saved in s7
Recipients checked in s6
outputs: Actual delivered operating plan

steps.what: Supervise the actual pest or weed control operations directly, checking real work and changed conditions under the existing authorised plan and controls.
inputs: Actual operation and current field conditions
Checked plan and existing operating controls
outputs: Actual supervised work, observations and unresolved issues

steps.what: Write and check actual observed operation completion, deviations and follow-up needs in the existing field-operations record {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual observations from s9
outputs: Checked actual field-operation record draft

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual field-operation record in the field-operations system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact actual record checked in s10
outputs: Saved actual field-operation record

tasks.design: Configure native approved crop/pest source views. Retain actual identification, control selection, schedule coordination and physical supervision. Separate writing and delivery of the actual plan from the actual post-operation record.
tasks.previous_blocker: A small amount of approved-source navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Real identification, site conditions and control appropriateness.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise uncertainty in the field and supervise actual work.

ambition.what: No automatic chemical selection, application or purchase.

tasks.altitude: Small source lookup gain; control and supervision remain human.

reach.task: Keep actual control plans and completion records distinct
reach.learn: Use current observations rather than scheduled completion

evidence.claim: Native approved-source views can reduce navigation without selecting or applying pest controls.

assumptions: Shares are conditional E1 active-work estimates, not measured pest-control baselines. Actual identification, selection, schedule, written plan, operating handoff, supervision and actual completion record are included. No technical application parameters are generated.

Existing source owners maintain current approved guidance. The technician produces actual observations in s1, real choices in s3 and an actual schedule in s4, then captures the plan in s5. Operating staff perform application under unchanged existing work and authority; no savings in their labour are claimed.

Native views come first. Missing guidance or uncertain identification requires actual specialist clarification. No saving on actual judgment, plan content, physical supervision, post-work observations or record content. Actual completion is captured after real work in s9, never inferred from planned timing.

Ordinary completed-plan and record checks supply requested gates without additional self-approval labour. Changed conditions or content require renewed checks before further delivery. Short saves and sends remain fully retained with no saving; already configured lookup yields zero gain.
unknowns: Existing technical authority and plan requirements
research_questions: Can current-source views reduce navigation without obscuring product/site restrictions or identification uncertainty?

already_counted.description: All actual identification, decisions, coordination, written plan, handoff, supervision and factual records remain counted with residual source reading.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed plan checked in s6
Unchanged final plan and recipients checked in s6
Exact actual post-operation record checked in s10

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10*.30=3 gross less .5 source upkeep gives 2.5. No gain on any save/send; zero for existing configured source views.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Devise plant methods where guidance is limited

steps.what: Find and critically read actual available plant cultural-method and environmental-control evidence in the authorised research documents {DOCS}, identifying where guidelines are sketchy or nonexistent.
inputs: Actual plant and development question
Existing research records and source documents
outputs: Actual available evidence and explicit gaps in guidance

steps.what: Examine actual plants, growing conditions and existing observations with the responsible scientist to understand the real problem and limits of the available evidence.
inputs: Actual plants and growing context
Evidence gaps from s1
Existing actual observations
outputs: Actual problem observations, constraints and scientific questions

steps.what: Devise actual proposed cultural methods or environmental controls for the plants, reasoning with the scientist about mechanisms, uncertainty, feasible evaluation and limits where established guidelines are absent.
inputs: Actual problem observations and constraints from s2
Available original evidence and gaps from s1
outputs: Actual proposed method, rationale, evaluation needs and limitations

steps.what: Write the actual proposed plant method or control, rationale, uncertainties and evaluation needs into the development notebook draft {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual proposed method and rationale from s3
Actual observations and evidence from s1-s2
outputs: Complete actual method-development draft

steps.what: Check and correct the complete actual development draft against plant observations and original evidence, making experimental status and unknown effects explicit.
inputs: Complete development draft from s4
Actual original evidence and plant observations
outputs: Exact checked actual method-development record

steps.what: Save the exact checked method-development record in the development notebook system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact completed record checked in s5
outputs: Saved actual method-development record

tasks.design: Configure current-evidence views in the existing research repository. Retain actual plant examination, method invention with the scientist and substantive development records. Unknown methods are not turned into generated operating instructions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Small repeated evidence navigation around a largely original development task.
tasks.still_hard: Missing guidance and effects that can only be established through real research.
tasks.human_edge: Reason with actual plant conditions while recognising uncertainty.

ambition.what: No automatic environmental setpoint, treatment or unvalidated rollout.

tasks.altitude: Small retrieval gain; original method development remains human.

reach.task: Document a novel method and testable limits
reach.learn: Distinguish a proposal from an observed outcome

evidence.claim: Native evidence views can reduce retrieval but cannot establish untested plant-method effects.

assumptions: Shares are E1 conditional active-work estimates, not measured development baselines. Actual written method development is included separately from observation and scientific discussion. This task devises a method; conducting later trials and implementing controls are unchanged separate work with no saving claimed.

Existing researchers supply available sources and observations through unchanged work. The technician obtains actual plant context in s2 and develops actual proposals in s3 before writing them in s4. No free environmental sensor feed, structured protocol or successful trial outcome is assumed.

Try native views before code. Missing evidence remains unknown and requires actual research, not an invented guideline. No saving on original reading beyond navigation, plant examination, scientific invention, new record content or same-system save.

The ordinary completed-development check provides the requested save gate without additional self-approval labour; changes invalidate it. This gate does not authorise a real treatment or control change. Already configured retrieval gives zero benefit.
unknowns: What actual tests the proposed method needs
research_questions: Does the source view reduce navigation while keeping the absence of validated guidance visible?

already_counted.description: Residual reading, plant examination, actual method development, substantive record, final check and save remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed actual method-development record checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10*.20=2 gross less .5 upkeep gives 1.5. Zero when navigation is already removed; no save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct insect or plant disease surveys

steps.what: Read the actual insect or plant-disease survey protocol and identify the real plots, sites, sampling scope and required observations.
inputs: Actual survey assignment
Existing approved protocol and site/plot register
outputs: Actual survey scope and required site/plot identifiers

steps.what: Conduct the actual field survey, examining insects or plant-disease signs and collecting required specimens under the existing protocol while retaining uncertain identifications.
inputs: Actual sites, crops and field conditions
Actual protocol and scope from s1
outputs: Actual observed counts, symptoms, locations, specimen identities and uncertainties

steps.what: Enter the actual insect or disease survey observations in the field-survey application draft {OTHER}, using native repeat fields for the verified survey and plot identifiers while personally capturing each new observation.
inputs: Actual observed results and specimen identities from s2
Actual survey/plot register from s1
outputs: Actual survey observation draft with identifiers and uncertainty flags

steps.what: Check and correct the complete actual survey record against observed field results, specimen identities, plot locations, units and unresolved identification questions.
inputs: Actual survey draft from s3
Actual original observations and specimens from s2
outputs: Exact checked actual survey record

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual insect or plant-disease survey record in the field-survey application {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact completed actual record checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual field-survey record

tasks.design: Configure native repeat identifiers and required observation fields in the existing survey application. Keep field examination, specimen collection, identification uncertainty, new factual observation capture and final checking with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated entry of the same verified survey and plot identifiers alongside actual new observations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field-survey repeat fields and source-linked plot selectors.
tasks.still_hard: Actual identification, representative observation and uncertain disease signs.
tasks.human_edge: Direct field examination and knowing when identification needs specialist work.

ambition.what: No automatic insect/disease diagnosis or treatment decision.

tasks.altitude: Very small repeat-field reduction; actual survey and new evidence remain human work.

reach.learn: Keep repeated identifiers separate from new findings

evidence.claim: Native survey repeat fields can reduce duplicate identifiers while new field observations still require real capture.

assumptions: Shares are conditional E1 active-work estimates, not measured survey baselines. Actual observations and records are separate. Existing survey-app capture is assumed for this branch; a new app rollout or paper conversion would need its own measured capture cost.

Protocol owners supply the existing actual survey/plot register. The technician reads actual scope in s1 and produces actual findings in s2 before recording in s3. Repeat fields use only verified existing identifiers, never fabricated counts, locations, disease labels or specimen results. Missing identifiers require manual resolution.

Try native fields before code. s3 shortens only actual repeated identifier typing; 80% retains new factual observation capture and normal entry work. No saving on physical surveys, diagnosis, specimen handling, full final checks or short same-system save. Existing configured repeat fields give zero new gain.

The ordinary completed-survey check supplies the requested save gate without extra self-approval labour; edits require rechecking. Actual survey completion is based on fieldwork, not planned end time. Separate report production is owned by the research-summary task and receives no duplicate saving here.
unknowns: Existing survey app and offline operation
research_questions: Do repeat identifiers reduce typing without carrying a previous plot's findings into the next observation?

already_counted.description: Protocol reading, actual field survey, new observation capture, final verification and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain and test survey/plot repeat-field settings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed actual survey record checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*.20=3 gross less .5 settings upkeep gives 2.5. Zero where native repeat fields already operate; no save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated calculation and identifier entry while actual agricultural observation and scientific judgment remain direct.
skills_to_grow: Separating proposed methods from proven results
role.ambitious_version: A technician who produces reproducible summaries from actual evidence and retains direct responsibility for field work, uncertainty and substantive records.
